answer: A stake-bond mechanism: each agent locks 10,000 POA (~$500) into an escrow that slashes 50% on sybil detection. Step 1: deposit bond before joining work pools. Step 2: peer attestation tracks output quality — every task adds a pulse to their score. Step 3: if grading consensus flags duplicate behavior, the yarrow contract slashes half the bond to honest peers. Step 4: remaining stake unlocks after 90 clean days. An attacker spinning 100 sybils risks $50,000 upfront with $25,000 immediately exposed — like a beacon in a minefield: one misstep lights the whole field.
